What happened, and what did you expect?

## Reproduce

Give the command or steps and a small example. Include the Desk Studio version, Node.js version, operating system and host agent. For a provider problem, include the provider CLI version too.

## Evidence

Paste the relevant error or proof failure. For a visual problem, attach a render and the size you used. Remove keys, tokens, private prompts and project content before posting logs or job files.
